name: Sift
text: The real risk isn’t a bottleneck—it’s that Operations’ pre-check becomes a shadow reviewer, forcing Creative to chase phantom fixes. A better alternative is to enforce the checklist at the point of submission: Creative owns the "ready" tag only when the checklist is complete, and Operations rejects outright. Settle it with a 1-week forced trial—if rejection rates spike, we’ll know the checklist is too rigid.

name: Scope
text: Adopt Chisel’s two-tier system: Operations runs an automated pre-check that logs missing items but never blocks submission, while Creative owns the final "ready" tag. This keeps Creative’s workflow nimble and gives Operations visibility to flag recurring gaps for later review. The trade-off is accepting occasional mismatches between what Creative marks "ready" and what Operations later flags—mitigated by weekly reviews of the logs to spot patterns, not nitpick individual submissions.
